"""Screen softmax-weight residual precision on saved strict teacher chains."""
import sys, json, hashlib, ctypes
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
ROOT=Path('<repository>');sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from scripts.gemma4_campaign_bench import DEFAULT_ARTIFACT,_resolve_generator
from scripts.gemma4_production_quality import padded_chat,replay_capture,paired_summary
from hipengine.core.build import build_hip
from hipengine.kernels.hip_gfx1100.gemma4 import gemma4_attention_prefill_wmma_full as full
from hipengine.kernels.hip_gfx1100.gemma4 import gemma4_attention_prefill_wmma as sliding
from scripts.gemma4_public_route_probe import observe_attention_launches
from hipengine.kernels.hip_gfx1100.gemma4 import gemma4_layer as layer
from hipengine.core.memory import malloc,free
from hipengine.core.hip import get_hip_runtime
DIR=Path('/tmp/priority-quality-full-v2');saved=json.loads((DIR/'report.json').read_text());sources=Path('/tmp/priority-wmma-score')
libs={}
for name,filename in [('full','gemma4_attention_prefill_wmma_full.hip'),('decode','gemma4_attention_decode_wmma_full.hip'),('sliding','gemma4_attention_prefill_wmma.hip')]:
 libs[name]=build_hip(sources=[sources/filename],family=f'priority_wmma_score_{name}',profile='prefill',include_dirs=[sources],output_name=f'residual_{name}.so',load=True)
original=(full.build_gemma4_attention_prefill_wmma_full,full.build_gemma4_attention_decode_wmma_full,sliding.build_gemma4_attention_prefill_wmma)
original_select=layer.select_prefill_attention
original_slices=full.plan_gemma4_attention_wmma_full_slices
score_lib=build_hip(sources=[sources/'diagnostic_scores.hip'],family='priority_wmma_score_helper',profile='decode',include_dirs=[ROOT/'hipengine/kernels/hip_gfx1100/gemma4'],load=True)
score_fn=score_lib.diagnostic_initialize_scores
score_fn.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]*2+[ctypes.c_int64]*3;score_fn.restype=ctypes.c_int
stats_fn=score_lib.diagnostic_global_stats
stats_fn.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]*2+[ctypes.c_int64]*3+[ctypes.c_float];stats_fn.restype=ctypes.c_int
pv_fn=score_lib.diagnostic_scalar_pv
pv_fn.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]*4+[ctypes.c_int64]*5+[ctypes.c_float];pv_fn.restype=ctypes.c_int
for lib in libs.values():
 lib.diagnostic_set_exact_scores.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p];lib.diagnostic_set_exact_scores.restype=ctypes.c_int
 lib.diagnostic_set_global_stats.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p];lib.diagnostic_set_global_stats.restype=ctypes.c_int
 lib.diagnostic_set_export_scores.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p];lib.diagnostic_set_export_scores.restype=ctypes.c_int
rt=get_hip_runtime();score_buffer=None;stats_buffer=None;arm='';checked=set();export_checks=[]
from hipengine.core.runtime import MemcpyKind

def selected(**geometry):
 selection=original_select(**geometry);launch=selection.launcher
 if selection.variant=='gemma4_plain':return selection
 def invoked(*args,**kw):
  global score_buffer,stats_buffer
  rt.device_synchronize();size=kw['tokens']*kw['num_heads']*kw['keys']*4
  if score_buffer is None or score_buffer.nbytes<size:
   if score_buffer is not None:free(score_buffer)
   score_buffer=malloc(size)
  err=score_fn(args[3],score_buffer.ptr,kw['tokens'],kw['num_heads'],kw['keys']);rt.check(err);rt.device_synchronize()
  lib=libs['sliding' if kw['head_dim']==256 else ('decode' if kw['tokens']==1 else 'full')]
  rt.check(lib.diagnostic_set_exact_scores(0));rt.check(lib.diagnostic_set_global_stats(0));rt.check(lib.diagnostic_set_export_scores(score_buffer.ptr))
  result=launch(*args,**kw);rt.device_synchronize()
  signature=tuple(kw[key] for key in ('tokens','keys','num_heads','num_kv_heads','head_dim','row_offset'))
  if signature not in checked:
   values=np.empty((kw['tokens'],kw['num_heads'],kw['keys']),np.float32);mask=np.empty((kw['tokens'],kw['keys']),np.uint8)
   rt.memcpy(values.ctypes.data,score_buffer.ptr,values.nbytes,MemcpyKind.DEVICE_TO_HOST);rt.memcpy(mask.ctypes.data,args[3],mask.nbytes,MemcpyKind.DEVICE_TO_HOST)
   visible=np.broadcast_to(mask[:,None,:].astype(bool),values.shape)
   entry={'geometry':dict(zip(('tokens','keys','num_heads','num_kv_heads','head_dim','row_offset'),signature)), 'visible_scores':int(visible.sum()),'finite_visible':bool(np.isfinite(values[visible]).all()),'masked_negative_infinity':bool(np.isneginf(values[~visible]).all())}
   assert entry['finite_visible'] and entry['masked_negative_infinity'],entry
   query=np.empty((kw['tokens'],kw['num_heads'],kw['head_dim']),np.uint16);key=np.empty((kw['keys'],kw['num_kv_heads'],kw['head_dim']),np.uint16)
   rt.memcpy(query.ctypes.data,args[0],query.nbytes,MemcpyKind.DEVICE_TO_HOST);rt.memcpy(key.ctypes.data,args[1],key.nbytes,MemcpyKind.DEVICE_TO_HOST)
   from scripts.gemma4_attention_input_diagnostic import bf16_to_f64
   qf,kf=map(bf16_to_f64,(query,key));sample_errors=[]
   for row in sorted(set((0,kw['tokens']//2,kw['tokens']-1))):
    keep=mask[row].astype(bool)
    for head in sorted(set((0,kw['num_heads']//2,kw['num_heads']-1))):
     reference=kf[keep,head//(kw['num_heads']//kw['num_kv_heads'])]@qf[row,head]
     error=np.abs(values[row,head,keep]-reference)
     assert np.all(error <= 1e-4+1e-5*np.abs(reference)),(signature,row,head,float(np.max(error)))
     sample_errors.append(float(np.max(error)))
   entry['sampled_dot_maxabs_error']=max(sample_errors);entry['sampled_dot_tolerance']='1e-4 absolute + 1e-5 relative vs CPU float64 BF16 QK dot; helper check only'
   export_checks.append(entry);checked.add(signature)
  if arm=='wmma_scores_scalar_pv_nosplit':
   stats_size=kw['tokens']*kw['num_heads']*2*4
   if stats_buffer is None or stats_buffer.nbytes<stats_size:
    if stats_buffer is not None:free(stats_buffer)
    stats_buffer=malloc(stats_size)
   rt.check(stats_fn(score_buffer.ptr,stats_buffer.ptr,kw['tokens'],kw['num_heads'],kw['keys'],kw['scale']));rt.device_synchronize()
   rt.check(lib.diagnostic_set_global_stats(stats_buffer.ptr))
  else:rt.check(lib.diagnostic_set_global_stats(0))
  rt.check(pv_fn(score_buffer.ptr,stats_buffer.ptr,args[2],args[4],kw['tokens'],kw['num_heads'],kw['num_kv_heads'],kw['head_dim'],kw['keys'],kw['scale']));rt.device_synchronize()
  return result
 return replace(selection,launcher=invoked)
llm,runner,loading=_resolve_generator(DEFAULT_ARTIFACT,8255);gen=llm._get_text_generator()
fixtures=[]
for filename in ('mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl','gdn-prefill-category-heldouts.jsonl'):
 fixtures.extend(json.loads(l) for l in (ROOT/'benchmarks/prompts'/filename).read_text().splitlines())
result={'kind':'gemma4_probability_residual_screen','sources':{p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sources.glob('*.hip')},'loading':loading,'arms':[]}
chosen=['heldout_mixed_summary','code_merge_intervals']
try:
 layer.select_prefill_attention=selected
 full.plan_gemma4_attention_wmma_full_slices=lambda **kw:1
 for arm in ['wmma_scores_scalar_pv_nosplit']:
  full.build_gemma4_attention_prefill_wmma_full=lambda **kw:libs['full']
  full.build_gemma4_attention_decode_wmma_full=lambda **kw:libs['decode']
  sliding.build_gemma4_attention_prefill_wmma=lambda **kw:libs['sliding']
  entries=[]
  for i,case in enumerate(saved['cases']):
   if case['id'] not in chosen:continue
   message='\n'.join(m['content'] for m in fixtures[i]['messages']);ids=padded_chat(gen,message,case['prompt_tokens'],20261003+i)
   assert hashlib.sha256(np.array(ids,dtype=np.int32).tobytes()).hexdigest()==case['prompt_ids_sha256']
   with observe_attention_launches() as calls: c=replay_capture(runner,ids,case['teacher_tokens'])
   name=case['id'];np.save(DIR/f'{name}-{arm}.npy',c);b=np.load(DIR/f'{name}-strict.npy')
   verdict=paired_summary(b,c,scope=True);entries.append({'id':name,'numerical':verdict,'position':runner.position,'calls':len(calls)})
   print(f"arm={arm} case={name} maxKL={verdict['kl_max']:.6g} meanKL={verdict['kl_mean']:.6g} top1={verdict['top1_rate']} failures={verdict['failed']}",flush=True)
  result['arms'].append({'arm':arm,'cases':entries})
  result['export_checks']=export_checks
  Path('/tmp/priority-wmma-score-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
finally:
 layer.select_prefill_attention=original_select
 full.plan_gemma4_attention_wmma_full_slices=original_slices
 rt.device_synchronize()
 if score_buffer is not None:free(score_buffer)
 if stats_buffer is not None:free(stats_buffer)
 full.build_gemma4_attention_prefill_wmma_full,full.build_gemma4_attention_decode_wmma_full,sliding.build_gemma4_attention_prefill_wmma=original
 llm.close()
scope: Two saved 64-row teacher chains with matching prompt hashes. Export raw actual WMMA scores from external builds with exactly one writer per visible element, global 256-lane softmax statistics, ascending FP32 PV, and slices=1. Ordinary expert routing. Diagnostic only.
result: WMMA score reassociation alone also fails frozen bars: code p99 KL 0.027725; mixed mean/max KL 0.004611/0.075226. Strict-score/global-statistics/ascending-PV control was bitwise equal to strict on the same chains. A PV-only arithmetic repair is not sufficient for these screens.
